# Wasserman 2020, The Flood: The Akkadian Sources (OBO 290) – text extraction

Plain-text extraction (poppler `pdftotext -layout`) of the PDF in this folder. Retrieved 2026-10-16. Page markers `<!-- pdf page N -->` refer to the PDF page index (not the printed page number). Layout spacing is kept as-is inside a fenced block per page; diacritics are as encoded in the PDF. Always verify against the PDF for brackets/half-brackets, superscripts and subscripts (superscript determinatives and subscript sign indices are flattened in this extraction).
